## Objective
- Build a complete, playable sword-fighting adventure inspired by the look and feel of *The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild*.
- The original game, **Wildermere — The Lost Vale**, has been implemented and is undergoing gameplay validation.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game without asking clarifying questions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for visual checks.

## Decisions
- Use original hand-drawn isometric scenery, artwork, and UI rather than Zelda assets.
- Provide keyboard and touch movement, sword attacks, dodge, enemy combat, health/stamina, a minimap, sound toggle, and victory/defeat screens.
- Attacks automatically target a nearby raider to make combat more reliable.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game interface, styling, and canvas game logic in `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js`.
- Corrected keyboard movement to map screen-space input to isometric world directions.
- Added an inline SVG favicon, resolving the reported favicon 404.
- Confirmed `node --check game.js` passes and the page loads without browser console errors.
- Tested keyboard attacks: the raider counter reached `2 / 8`.
- Tested defeat and restart: defeat screen appeared; restart restored `100` health, `0 / 8` kills, and hid the end screen.
- Confirmed touch controls render on a 390×844 viewport and touch attack can defeat a raider.
- Inspected a mobile screenshot at `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/output/page-2026-11-13T15-16-02-650Z.png`.

### Active
- Validate complete quest progression to `8 / 8` and the victory screen; current tests did not reach victory.
- Further verify touch movement and dodge; the mouse-based joystick attempt did not confirm successful movement.

- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue browser testing combat and movement; confirm the counter reaches `8 / 8` and the victory screen appears.
2. Verify touch joystick and dodge behavior, and save/inspect a final small JPEG screenshot if visual changes are needed.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface, HUD, controls, and inline favicon.
- `styles.css`: Responsive game presentation and touch controls.
- `game.js`: World rendering, movement, combat, enemies, and game state.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Existing screenshots include `/tmp/opencode/wildermere.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/wildermere-test.jpg`; the latest inspected screenshot is PNG, not JPEG.
